digest.component_or_area: Documentation generation and config reference system
propositions: A new generator script must produce fully-generated config-reference.md and security.md from config schema, deprecation registries, and secret-name inventories without modifying the existing hand-authored config.md
The generator must expose a --check drift mode that detects staleness with newline normalization and is gated by a pytest suite running under make test
Both generated docs must carry a top-of-file banner within 8 lines naming the generator command and must be registered in the GENERATED map and docs/README.md table

The generated docs must collectively cover all required topics: precedence, source, lifecycle, restart/redeploy rotation, native refresh, observability exception, subprocess limitations, behavior deltas, and MCP/CLI exposure
All existing consumers of docs/config.md (content-asserting tests and anchor deep links) must remain intact and functional
The generator must read lifecycle information from deprecation registries filtered by kind=='cfg' and populate a lifecycle column in the generated reference tables
